LanguageData.WBD_DefaultsTip: Save, apply or manage the default setups (bills, storage, plant) for this type of building. With several buildings selected, applying acts on all of them.
LanguageData.WBD_RenameFailed: Could not rename to "{0}" (name already used or empty).
LanguageData.WBD_SaveBusy: Could not save right now (the game is saving). Please try again in a moment.
LanguageData.WBD_OverviewEmpty: No presets saved yet. Select a workbench (or shelf) in-game and use "Defaults → Save current setup as preset…".
LanguageData.WBD_SettingAutoApply: Automatically apply the default preset's bills to newly built workbenches
LanguageData.WBD_SettingShowTabButton: Show the "Defaults" button in the Bills tab
LanguageData.WBD_SettingShowGizmo: Show the "Defaults" command button on selected buildings
LanguageData.WBD_PawnDefaultsTip: Save this colonist's setup (schedule, work, policies, hostility, medical) as a preset, or apply a saved preset to the selected colonist(s).
LanguageData.WBD_PawnSaveAsPreset: Save this colonist's setup as preset…
LanguageData.WBD_PawnNoPreset: That pawn preset is empty or missing.
LanguageData.WBD_PawnDefaultSet: "{0}" is now the default applied to new colonists.
LanguageData.WBD_PawnAutoApply: Automatically apply the default preset to new colonists (once each)
LanguageData.WBD_PawnShowGizmo: Show the "Defaults" command button on selected colonists
LanguageData.WBD_PawnIncludeChildren: Also apply to children (work priorities take effect once they can work)
LanguageData.WBD_PawnSkipWorkFreeWill: Let Free Will manage work priorities (skip the work axis for pawns it controls)
LanguageData.WBD_PawnFreeWillNote: Free Will is active. It continuously rewrites work priorities, so a default would be overwritten; the work axis is skipped for the colonists it manages.
LanguageData.WBD_PawnAxesHeader: Which settings to save and apply
LanguageData.WBD_PawnOverviewEmpty: No pawn presets saved yet. Select a colonist in-game and use "Defaults → Save this colonist's setup as preset…".
LanguageData.WBD_SettingNativeBillCap: Raise the workbench bill limit above the vanilla 15 (built in, no other mod needed)
LanguageData.WBD_BillCapNote: This lets a single workbench hold more active bills. A workbench runs all of its bills, so a very high limit can affect performance. Restored defaults also respect this limit.
LanguageData.WBD_BillCapExternal: "No Max Bills" is active, so the workbench bill limit is already raised. The cap below is used when restoring saved bills.
LanguageData.WBD_PolicyDefaultsHeader: Default policies that travel across saves
LanguageData.WBD_PolicyAutoApply: Also apply the saved policies once to each new game (off by default)
LanguageData.WBD_PolicyCrossSaveSaved: Saved this colony's policies as the cross-save default set.
LanguageData.WBD_PolicyCrossSaveApplied: Applied the saved default policies to this colony.
LanguageData.WBD_PolicyNoGame: Load a colony to manage its policies (this section needs an active game).
LanguageData.WBD_PolicyColonyDefaultsHeader: Colony default policy (applied to new colonists)
LanguageData.WBD_PolicyDefaultSet: "{0}" is now the colony default for new colonists.
LanguageData.WBD_Section_buildings_Desc: Bills, storage filters and plants per building type, the Defaults button, auto-apply on new construction.
LanguageData.WBD_Section_zones_Desc: Presets for stockpile, dumping and growing zones. New zones you draw start with the default.
LanguageData.WBD_Section_pawns_Desc: Colonist presets (schedule, work, policies, hostility, medical), applied once to each new colonist.
LanguageData.WBD_Section_policies_Desc: Outfit, drug, food and reading policies that travel from save to save.
LanguageData.WBD_Section_colony_Desc: Medical care per pawn type, auto home area, auto rebuild and manual priorities, set for every new colony.
LanguageData.WBD_Section_library_Desc: Named profiles of your defaults, and share strings to copy them to another player or computer.
LanguageData.WBD_SettingStorageOnBuild: Give newly built shelves and storage their default filter
LanguageData.WBD_SettingPlantOnBuild: Give newly built hydroponics and other plant growers their default plant
LanguageData.WBD_SettingZoneOnCreate: Give new stockpile and dumping zones their default filter
LanguageData.WBD_SettingGrowingOnCreate: Give new growing zones their default plant
LanguageData.WBD_SettingBenchFamilies: Bench families: a building without its own preset uses the default of a closely related one (all stoves, all smithies)
LanguageData.WBD_SettingFilterIntent: Filters remember categories, so items a mod adds to a category later are included
LanguageData.WBD_SettingMatchStockpile: Restore "specific stockpile" in bills when this colony has a stockpile of that name
LanguageData.WBD_LibraryReadOnly: Library.xml could not be read, so presets are read-only for now. Nothing was overwritten. The previous version is Library.xml.bak in the same folder.
LanguageData.WBD_MissingUnknownDefs: {0} entries this game does not know
LanguageData.WBD_ShareInvalid: That is not a usable Set my Defaults string ({0}).
LanguageData.WBD_ShareEmpty: That string is valid but holds nothing.
LanguageData.WBD_BillsSkippedMissing: {0} bill(s) skipped, their recipe is not in this game ({1}). They stay in the preset.
LanguageData.WBD_ZoneDefaultsTip: Save this zone's filter or plant as a preset, or apply one to every selected zone. New zones you draw start with the default.
LanguageData.WBD_ColonyHeader: Colony settings that travel across saves (medical care per pawn type, auto home area, auto rebuild, manual priorities)
LanguageData.WBD_ColonyApplyOnNewGame: Apply the saved colony settings when a new game starts
LanguageData.WBD_ColonySaved: Saved this colony's settings for every new game.
LanguageData.WBD_ColonyApplied: Applied the saved colony settings to this colony.
LanguageData.WBD_ColonyNoneSaved: Nothing saved yet. Load a colony and press "Save this colony's settings".
